_comment: Deployment profile TEMPLATE. Placeholders only — never commit a filled-in copy.
Mount the real file from a ConfigMap and point SN_PROFILE_FILE at it, or override
individual keys with SN_PROFILE__<path>__<key> environment variables.
Secrets are NOT stored here: this file names the environment variables that hold
them, so the ConfigMap stays free of secret material and the Secret stays the
only place values live.
style: 'standard' is RFC 6749 client-credentials with Basic built from id and
secret. 'preencoded' is the variant flow: an opaque pre-encoded Basic
credential, with id and secret also repeated in the body. One live token call
decides which a given gateway wants; the answer is this value, not a code change.
_extra_headers_comment: Some gateways require an extra per-call header. Give it here as a literal, or
as 'env:VAR_NAME' to resolve from the environment. Nothing gateway-specific is

_comment: Where each logical operation goes in THIS deployment. '{table}' is substituted
from the entity map. '{record}' is optional: include it when the gateway
addresses the record in the path, omit it when the identifier belongs in the
body. The package assumes neither.
Method is configured, not assumed — update verbs differ between gateways.
Disabled until a create endpoint is confirmed in writing.
base_url (optional, any operation): overrides the profile-level base for
THIS operation only. Needed when one operation lives on a different host
or API version than the rest of the gateway - the only field-proven
create endpoint does exactly that. Omit it when the shared base applies.
Logical name -> real table, plus deny-by-default field allow-lists.
A field absent from read_fields is never requested; a field absent from
write_fields can never be written, whatever the model asks for.
Leave write_fields empty to make an entity strictly read-only.

_coded_fields_comment: Field -> {stored code: human label}, for fields that store codes.
Used in BOTH directions: codes become labels on read, labels become codes
on write. Declare these. A code handed to a language model without its
meaning does not get reported as a code - it gets a meaning invented for it,
and inconsistently: the same code was rendered 'New' on one run and 'Open'
on the next. An undeclared code is tagged '<unmapped code N>' rather than
passed through bare, so the model repeats it instead of explaining it.

params._comment: Wire names for query parameters. Defaults suit ServiceNow-style APIs.

_comment: keys_env names an environment variable holding a comma-separated ordered list
of HMAC signing keys. The first signs; all of them verify, which makes rotation
zero-downtime. Sourcing from the secret manager is required: generating a key
per process appears to work on one replica and silently fails as soon as a
change is proposed on one pod and committed on another.
auto_approve_fields is empty by default. Nothing bypasses the gate unless a
deployment deliberately opts a low-risk journal field in.

_correlation_field_comment: Optional field on the record where this package stamps the correlation id, so the agent-side trail joins to the system-of-record side. Leave null if no such field exists.
